def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height separator lines split the board into panels.
    rowcuts = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 9]
    colcuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 9]
    # Grid background is the most common color; separator lines are uniform but
    # are removed from panel boundaries before selecting the populated panel.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    rowbounds = [-1] + rowcuts + [h]
    colbounds = [-1] + colcuts + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rowbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rowbounds[ri]+1, rowbounds[ri+1]
        if r0 >= r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(colbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = colbounds[ci]+1, colbounds[ci+1]
            if c0 >= c1: continue
            pane = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            count = sum(v != bg for row in pane for v in row)
            panels.append((r0,c0,pane,count))
    src = max(panels, key=lambda x:x[3])
    sh, sw = len(src[2]), len(src[2][0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in [rowbounds[i]+1 for i in range(len(rowbounds)-1)]:
        if r0 >= h: continue
        for c0 in [colbounds[i]+1 for i in range(len(colbounds)-1)]:
            if c0 >= w: continue
            for dr in range(sh):
                for dc in range(sw):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = src[2][dr][dc]
    return out
